title: Matrix 2x1 super-tile: two resident C tiles across K with optional W reuse
scope: logic simulation only; no synthesis, Vivado, STA, board, VNC or push; no frequency or whole-model seconds claim

phases.name: read v024 decisions/input, root README, v023 ds_matrix REPORT/INTERFACE/RTL
audit the claimed 2x1 super-tile: C slots, W pinning, ports, release, RAW
implement optional W-reuse schedule and decoupled A/W stage ports
independent gold, fixtures, real RTL regression M32/64/96 N32/64 K1/32/96/tail, old-C/overflow/parity/fault
actual AXI W bytes, capacity inventory, writeback interface patch

tests.hazard_counters: haz_a=0, haz_w=0 in all normal/backpressure/fault runs

fixed_findings: abort did not drop unposted cseg queue; overflow fault could hang WAITDRAIN

known_limits: v1 serializes result0 on cwr_idle before br1 final-K write stream
odd M96 tail tile uses single-tile path; no W reuse
one result payload; no simultaneous two-tile result
cache_hits=0 by design; each tile computed once per task
